## 📋 Summary

## 🔍 Change type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance
- [ ] Security

## 🧪 Validation
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-docs.js`
- [ ] Relevant tests added or executed

## 🖼️ UI evidence
Add genuine screenshots for UI changes. Do not include real contact data.

## 🔐 Safety and privacy
- [ ] No secrets or personal contact records included.
- [ ] Data handling and accessibility impacts considered.

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Existing behavior preserved or change documented.
- [ ] README and relevant docs updated.
- [ ] Known limitations recorded.
